channel.title: ABDALLAH ABAS Blog
channel.description: Practical articles on online earning, SEO and web building

item.title: The Road to AdSense (1): Foundations You Build Before Your First Post
item.description: Part one of The Road to AdSense series: the seven decisions to make before writing a single post — niche, domain, page structure, navigation, performance, indexing, and legal pages — with a final pre-launch checklist.

item.title: The Road to AdSense (2): Your First 30 Posts — a No-Filler, No-Duplicate Plan
item.description: Part two of The Road to AdSense series: a practical plan for your first thirty posts — topic clusters, search-intent distribution, a realistic publishing schedule, and an internal-linking plan from day one — plus the list of what you must never write at this stage.

item.title: AdSense Approval Checklist: 14 Points to Review Before You Hit Submit
item.description: Before requesting AdSense approval, review these fourteen points in order: content, legal pages, navigation, speed, and indexing — so your site enters review from the strongest possible position.

item.title: Search Console From Zero: Your First 7 Steps After Adding a Site
item.description: A practical guide to your first week with Google Search Console: property setup, sitemap submission, indexing checks, and reading the performance report — ordered steps with no technical background needed.

item.title: Core Web Vitals: What Google Actually Measures About Your Site's Speed
item.description: A plain-language breakdown of the three Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) with their official thresholds, why slow sites lose rankings and revenue — plus the first 6 fixes with real impact.

item.title: A Simple Monthly Content Plan: Publishing 8 Articles a Month Without Burning Out
item.description: A practical system for planning your blog's monthly content: from an idea tank to a flexible publishing calendar, using Search Console keyword data — no burnout, no team.

item.title: Free Tools Every Content Creator Needs (Running Directly in the Browser)
item.description: A pack of free tools I actually use daily: word counter, text cleaner, slug generator, JSON formatter, color converter — all running in the browser with no file uploads or subscriptions.
